20.  (1)  The  Minister  shall  appoint  a  person  who  shall
have fifteen years of academic or professional experience in
the  fields  of  education,  natural  science,  social  and  human
science, culture, communication, administration or finance
as the Deputy Secretary General of the Commission (in this
Act referred to as a Deputy Secretary General).
(2) The Deputy Secretary General shall assist the Secretary
General to exercise, perform and discharge the powers, duties
and functions of the Commission and carry out the duties
assigned by the Secretary General.
(3)  Deputy  Secretary  General  shall  function  as  the
Secretary  to  the  UNESCO  General  Conference  of  the
Commission.
(4)  The  Deputy  Secretary  General  may  be  paid  such
remuneration in such manner and at such rates as may be
determined  by  the  Minister  with  the  concurrence  of  the
Minister assigned the subject of finance.
21. (1) The Secretary General and the Deputy Secretary
General shall hold office for a period of four years and shall
be eligible for re-appointment for not more than one further
term of office whether consecutive or otherwise.
(2)  The  Minister  may  for  reasons  assigned  remove  the
Secretary General or the Deputy Secretary General from office
after  considering  and  affording  an  opportunity  to  the
Secretary General or the Deputy Secretary General as the
case  may  be  to  respond  to  any  allegations  made  against
them.
